metadata.description: Claude Code plugin for building a topic ontology through an interview, continuous ingestion and composition of released topics

plugins.name: general-ontology
plugins.description: The onto CLI, MCP server, session-start hook and six skills (onto, onto-interview, onto-ingest, onto-review, onto-compose and onto-deliver) for building a topic ontology one discovery at a time: interview questions ranked by gaps, sanitized sources, quote-checked proposals that a person reviews, richness that grows, and releases other topics can import. The data lives in the topic repo created by onto init.
